Document verification

How a document gets reviewed

Explore the workflow

A blurred scan comes in. We clean up the image and convert it into text the model can read.

The model identifies the document type and extracts key fields. A low-confidence result goes to a reviewer.

The reviewer compares the result with the original document and confirms or corrects what the model found.

About me

I’ve spent more than 10 years in product management across data, business intelligence and enterprise AI. I started in BI and went on to co-found a retail BI company.

At evoke, I work with executives to set priorities and with my squad to turn them into products. I stay hands-on with the parts that shape delivery, including model evaluation, governance and where a person needs to make the call.

Helping teams adopt AI

AI Buddy

I founded AI Buddy at evoke’s Israel site and lead the program. We pair colleagues who have hands-on AI experience with people who bring a real task they want to improve. In weekly sessions, teams share the agents and workflows they built so others can reuse them.
